name: Shadow Fleet
designation_status: Union operational designation; not confirmed as the fleet's self-name.
canon_observations: Operated multiple vessels with cloaking, signature displacement, or related concealment capability.
Used hit-and-run fire, coordinated approach geometry, boarding forces, distributed command networking, decoys, and sensor charges.
Fielded a command flagship operationally designated Crown Dark.
Deployed personnel carrying an isolation artifact translated as the Third Silence.
Continued operations near the concealed vessel after Crown Dark's collapse, though centralized coordination degraded.
At least some personnel identified themselves through a translated phrase rendered as Those Who Remained After the First Dark.
Withdrew from the Lethan system after the sensor flare exposed concealment and Crown Dark was lost.
Detached six vessels toward Continuance during the withdrawal; Watchfire and the bulker's defensive assets repelled the attack.
Used multiple transition vectors, false wakes, and sensor charges to cover its retreat.
Surviving fleet strength, destination, and regrouping posture remain unknown.
motive_leads_staging: Shadow personnel state that the fleet entered Lethan to return what had been removed from the concealed vessel.
Eira states that the fleet also intended to recover minds carrying an open pattern.
Shadow personnel describe the Third Silence as one of three commands or isolation artifacts.
The fleet appears to regard observation and memory as possible transmission or exposure routes.
The fleet feared the sensor flare or recognition event and treated its occurrence as a reason for rapid withdrawal.
The fleet may possess prior experience with multiple related Dark Star phenomena or structures.
unknowns: whether all ships and crews share one allegiance
whether Those Who Remained After the First Dark is a polity, oath, survivor category, or translation artifact
whether the fleet's stated containment purpose is complete, accurate, or shared by all vessels
whether the fleet will return to Lethan or target the seventeen exposed vectors

command_model.observed: Crown Dark coordinated fleet movement through distributed living operators and short-range command transmissions.
command_model.post_crown_dark: Central coordination degraded after Crown Dark's collapse; surviving vessels retained enough local autonomy to cover withdrawal, attack Continuance, deploy decoys, and escape through multiple transition vectors.
command_model.boundary: The existence of distributed command does not establish that every person or vessel participates in a single collective consciousness.

promotion_pass: Dark Star Narrative Reconciliation Pass — 2026-07-22; Third Silence Narrative Audit — 2026-07-22
description: A hidden fleet that operated through the Kharis Sector without coherent detection — damaged escorts, extraction ships attached to the concealed command vessel (Crown Dark), and distant heavy units. Withdrew from the ruins of Crown Dark; active strength unknown.
reconciliation_note: Reconciled 2026-07-21 from committed Dark Star arc canon (narrative v1.1 + AAR + event_dark_star_incident). Derivation from established canon, additive; prior fields preserved.

route_exemption.basis: Canon attests that the Shadow Fleet operated through the Kharis Sector without coherent detection and withdrew from the Lethan system. Both are canonical places; no corridor between them is named in canon.
route_exemption.why_not_invented: The Hollow Expanse is typed a lawless corridor used for shadow logistics and would be a plausible citation, but canon establishes NO link between it and the Shadow Fleet. Citing it would be inference presented as fact.
route_exemption.resolves_when: A named route is established, or canon links the Shadow Fleet to an existing corridor.
